LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 11.1.1 CONVERSATIONAL SKILLS: INTERVIEWS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Conversational Skills: interviews
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Conversational Skills: interviews, part of Strand 11 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use polite language during an interview? 2. How do we show respect for other people’s opinion?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is promoted as the learner observes the rules of engagement while playing different roles as interviewee or

interviewer.

• Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses both the radio and television as sources of information.

Values:
• Respect: It is developed as the learner disagrees politely while conducting the interview.

• Unity: It is promoted as the learner endeavours to achieve a common goal while organising and engaging in interviews

with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is achieved as the learner acquires skills for expressing opinions.

Link to other Learning Areas:
